description: IP Risk Detection RG: trademark Graphic Detection API.

imageUrl.description: Product image URL or base64-encoded image data, maximum 1000 characters

productTitle.description: Product title, used for context-aware detection, max 1000 characters

regions.description: Country/region codes to be detected, separate with commas if multiple. If not transmitted, all countries will be detected by default. Optional values: `US`, `WO`, `ES`, `GB`, `DE`, `IT`, `CA`, `MX`, `EM`, `AU`, `FR`, `JP`, `TR`, `BX`, `CN`

topNumber.description: Returns the maximum number of YOLO coordinates, ranging from 1-100; the actual number returned may be less than the number of parameters passed

trademarkName.description: Possible graphic logo names, used to narrow the search scope, maximum 1000 characters
